methodology.cold: new application Catalog, OS caches not flushed
methodology.memory: maximum observed working set/RSS during each complete scenario, then summarized across runs
methodology.node: long-lived headless benchmark process; includes runtime, reused heap and previous samples; not full Workbench memory
methodology.rust: 50 ms polling attempts through a PowerShell helper on Windows; short workers/peaks can be missed; no observation remains null
methodology.storage: sum of logical file sizes under disposable cache root after the scenario; includes metadata and any retained files; not peak temporary disk or allocated filesystem blocks
methodology.scope: cold includes refresh, queries, folding and targeted decode; warm omits input decode
methodology.medium_evidence: same-session existing ABBA blocks reused; small/large measured afterward
methodology.uncertainty: small cohort first run and large cohort first run can include extra OS-cache warmup; sample ranges retained
